name: Rama Steel Tubes Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1974, Rama steel tubes is one of the leading manufacturers of Steel Pipes & Tubes, Rigid PVC & G.I. Pipes and square section products in India. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The company's product range includes MS ERW black pipes from 15mm to 800 mm diameter pipes and G.I. Pipes from 15mm to 150 mm NB in light, medium, and heavy sizes, Hollow Sections, Structural Steels, Scaffolding, Electricity Poles, Casing Swaged Poles, and other Structural Steel Products. [1] [2]

pros: Company's median sales growth is 25.7% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 3.53 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -10.1%
Company has a low return on equity of 8.66% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.19.2 Cr.
